title: Tierra Viva - Design by Automobili Lamborghini | Benahavis, Marbella, Spain
content: Tierra Viva is an architectural masterpiece of 53 luxury villas perched on the hills of Benahavis, overlooking the Mediterranean Sea and Marbella coast. Styled with Lamborghini's aerodynamic contours, premium finishes, and supercar-inspired designs.
